checks: Version 5 saves migrate without inventing lovers; invalid agreements and dates are rejected
Affection never overrides a friend answer, and a pending answer halves recurring gains for fourteen days
A second disclosure remains a proposal until the actual group conversation grants consent
Conditional consent counts two completed dates once each and waits for an explicit review
A missed trial deadline offers a real decision instead of silently approving the new relationship
A refused agreement cannot be forced by an affection value or a scene choice
Hidden relationships can be disclosed; only a real lover witnessing a date schedules a clash
Being honest after a clash uses the higher consent threshold and never treats an apology as consent
Lovers have a seven-day absence boundary, while ordinary friends retain fourteen days
scope: Production relationship, migration, social date, witness and greeting modules; browser layout checked separately.
